archive_listing.entry_types: 44 regular files; no directory, symbolic-link, hard-link or special entries

procedure: Make a new empty directory: mktemp -d (outside the repository).
With umask 022, run: tar -xzf codex-0.160.0-darwin-arm64.tgz -C <new directory>.
Measure the source subtree <new directory>/package/vendor/aarch64-apple-darwin as the codex-vendor-tree-v1 root.
Do not run npm, package scripts or any file from the archive during extraction or measurement.
mode_provenance: The archive carries no directory entries, so bsdtar creates directories with the extracting umask: 0755 under umask 022. File modes 0755/0644 come from the archive headers and are unchanged by umask 022. A different umask yields different directory or file modes and therefore a different tree.

measurement.scanner: author's standard-library descriptor-relative, no-follow scanner run with python3 -I: refuses symbolic links, special files, regular files with link count other than one, unrepresentable names and detected mutation; records root '.' and every descendant with st_mode & 07777, and size and SHA-256 for files
measurement.validation: distribution-s1 model.inventory.validate returned no problems; model.inventory.manifest recomputation equals manifest_sha256
measurement.independent_cross_check: app/packaging/inventory.py scan() on the same fresh tree gives the same paths, kinds, modes, sizes and SHA-256 values and the same manifest; it reports 30 Mach-O files and only dir/file kinds
measurement.repeatability: the fresh extraction and HELP_HUMAN's earlier cache extraction give byte-identical inventory JSON
measurement.probe_effect: re-inventory of the fresh tree after the label probe is byte-identical to the pre-probe inventory
